1.w: Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus being in Philippi, with the overseers and deacons:

2.w: Grace to you⁺ and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

3.w: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you⁺,

4.w: always in my every supplication for all of you⁺, making the supplication with joy,

5.w: for your⁺ partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,

6.w: being persuaded of this very thing, that the One having begun a good work in you⁺ will complete [it] until the day of Christ Jesus.

7.w: Accordingly, it is right for me to think this about all of you⁺, because of me having you⁺ in the heart. Both in my chains and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel, you⁺ all are fellow partakers of grace with me.

8.w: For God [is] my witness how I long for you⁺ all in the inner affections of Christ Jesus.

9.w: And this I pray, that your⁺ love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

10.w: for you⁺ to approve the things being excellent, so that you⁺ may be pure and blameless unto the day of Christ,

11.w: being filled with the fruit of righteousness that [is] through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

12.w: Now I want you⁺ to know brothers, that the things concerning me really have come to the advancement of the gospel,

13.w: so as for my chains in Christ to have become manifest in all the Praetorium and to all the rest;

14.w: and most of the brothers, trusting in the Lord by my chains, dare more abundantly to speak fearlessly the word.

15.w: Indeed, some, even through envy and strife, but some also through goodwill, preach Christ—

16.w: the ones indeed out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel;

17.w: but the [others] proclaim Christ out of self-interest, not purely, supposing to add tribulation to my chains.

18.w: What then? Only that in every way, whether in pretext or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will rejoice,

19.w: for I know that this will turn out for me to deliverance, through your⁺ supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

20.w: according to my eager expectation and hope that I will be ashamed in nothing, but in all boldness, as always, also now, Christ will be magnified in my body, whether through life or through death.

21.w: For to me, to live [is] Christ and to die [is] gain.

22.w: But if [I am] to live in flesh, this for me [is] the fruit of work; and what will I choose? I do not know.

23.w: But I am pressed by the two, having the desire to depart and to be with Christ, for [it is] very much better,

24.w: but to remain in the flesh [is] more necessary on account of you⁺.

25.w: And having been persuaded of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you⁺ for your⁺ progress and joy of the faith,

26.w: so that through my coming to you⁺ again your⁺ boasting in me may abound in Christ Jesus.

27.w: Only conduct yourselves worthily of the gospel of Christ, so that, whether having come and having seen you⁺, or being absent, I might hear the things concerning you⁺, that you⁺ stand firm in one spirit, contending together with one mind for the faith of the gospel,

28.w: and not being frightened in [anything] by those opposing [you], which is a demonstration of destruction to them, but of salvation to you⁺—and this from God.

29.w: For it was granted to you⁺ on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer on behalf of Him,

30.w: having the same struggle such as you⁺ saw in me and now hear of in me.
